name: [CH] Endpoint Apps - Chat & Messaging [is]
description: Intent: [CH] Cyberhaven-curated Chat and Messaging app names — Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram desktop, WhatsApp desktop, Signal, Matrix clients, etc. Drives the Chat/Messaging sub-segmentation on M5050 under the M5000 umbrella; corporate messaging (Slack, Teams) is intentionally included so analysts see volume, not just shadow IM. Curated baseline. Exclusions: do not remove curated entries; if a corporate-sanctioned tool needs exemption, gate it at the warn/block tier via user-conditions rather than trimming this list.
